sv_benchmarks.note: Tasks are copied with their .yml trimmed to the task's property (`property`, no-data-race where it names none); the .yml of an original task is c/<origin>. Licences are those of the task's directory (SPDX header or LICENSE file), texts in c/LICENSES/.

sv_comp_2026_source: verified and validated result XMLs of Goblint, Dartagnan, ULTIMATE Automizer in C.no-data-race.Concurrency, 2026-01, for the tasks without their own sv_comp_2026_source; cpu_s is CPU time of the component's own run

goblint-1s.purpose: Goblint with a CPU-time limit of 1 s in phase 1, then Dartagnan in phase 2 with a memory limit of 70 % of the run's, on a task where a level of Goblint's portfolio reaches the CPU-time limit: the limit ends that level, the runner gives up the rest, and phase 2 answers.

tasks.name: goblint-regression/28-race_reach_41-trylock_racefree
tasks.purpose: Goblint answers true in 0.1 s; neither Dartagnan nor ULTIMATE Automizer answers, so only a working Goblint can give the verdict.

tasks.name: pthread-theta/unwind3-100
tasks.purpose: Goblint answers true; the others do not.

tasks.name: goblint-regression/28-race_reach_01-simple_racing
tasks.purpose: Goblint answers true; the others do not.

tasks.name: pthread-divine/tls_basic
tasks.purpose: Dartagnan answers true; Goblint gives unknown and ULTIMATE Automizer no answer. The no-data-race hand-over task (check 8): in svcomp27 sv-sanitizers reaches its CPU-time limit of 30 s, Goblint ends in unknown in phase 1 and is not started again in phase 2, and Dartagnan answers true in phase 2.

tasks.name: pthread-divine/ring_1w1r-1
tasks.purpose: Dartagnan answers false and Theta's validator confirms its witness (ULTIMATE Automizer's validator reaches the 90 s limit on it); the others give no answer. Goblint ends in unknown after 2.2 s CPU time.

tasks.name: goblint-regression/09-regions_01-list_rc
tasks.purpose: Dartagnan answers false on a .c task (preprocessed by the component) and ULTIMATE Automizer's validator confirms its witness; Goblint ends in unknown after 0.8 s and ULTIMATE Automizer times out. Replaces pthread-divine/ring_1w1r-2, where Goblint's own run needs 169 s CPU time to end in unknown, which with a working Goblint in front of Dartagnan exceeds the suite's limits.

tasks.name: ldv-races/race-4_1-thread_local_vars
tasks.purpose: The only task of the category on which ULTIMATE Automizer alone answers true; the heaviest task of the suite (42 s CPU in SV-COMP 2026).

tasks.name: pthread-theta/unwind2-nondet
tasks.purpose: ULTIMATE Automizer answers true, Dartagnan does not; Goblint answers it in its own entry, so a Goblint that works hides ULTIMATE Automizer in a configuration that starts with Goblint.

tasks.name: goblint-regression/04-mutex_50-funptr_rc
tasks.purpose: ULTIMATE Automizer alone answers false on a .c task (preprocessed by the component) that calls a function through a pointer; Theta's validator confirms its witness.

tasks.name: goblint-regression/04-mutex_21-sound_base
tasks.purpose: sv-sanitizers answers false in 0.4 s and ConcurrentWitness2Test confirms its YAML 2.2 witness; Goblint ends in unknown after 0.7 s, and Dartagnan svcomp27 answers false without a witness (it reports an invalid function pointer), which a no-data-race false cannot be delivered without, so in svcomp27 only sv-sanitizers gives the verdict. ULTIMATE Automizer (pool) also answers false alone on this .c task (preprocessed by the component), and ConcurrentWitness2Test confirms its witness too.

tasks.name: lp64/race-only-on-lp64
tasks.purpose: A data race only when sizeof(long) == 8: expected false under LP64.  ULTIMATE Automizer answers true if given ILP32, so CoOpeRace must pass the task's data model. ULTIMATE Automizer's validator confirms the witnesses of both owners.

tasks.name: lp64/race-only-on-ilp32
tasks.purpose: The same program with the indices swapped: no race under LP64, expected true; ULTIMATE Automizer given ILP32 reports a race.

tasks.name: goblint-regression/04-mutex_19-call_by_ptr_rc
tasks.purpose: Run by goblint-1s only, a hand-over task (check 8). A level of Goblint's portfolio uses more than 1 s of CPU time, so the 1 s limit ends it (goblint exited with code -24) and the runner gives up the remaining levels; Dartagnan answers false in phase 2 and ULTIMATE Automizer's validator confirms its witness. Goblint's own run needs 54 s to end in unknown, too long for the other configurations.

tasks.name: libvsync/clhlock
tasks.purpose: sv-sanitizers answers false(valid-deref) in 0.4 s; Goblint ends in unknown after 7.9 s and Deagle in unknown after 0.4 s, so in the valid-memsafety strategy only sv-sanitizers gives the verdict. Its witness has one target waypoint and is of format 2.0, which does not pass the check; a valid-memsafety false needs none (demo mode), so CoOpeRace prints the false without a witness. No validator is named: ULTIMATE Automizer svcomp27-violation runs out of memory on the witness (4 GB and 7 GB) and Theta svcomp27-validator reaches 90 s; on the two other tasks where only sv-sanitizers answers (goblint-regression/28-race_reach_86 and 87) Automizer runs out of memory as well and Theta ends in ERROR (frontend failed).

tasks.purpose: iekke 1.0 answered true in 29 s in SV-COMP 2026, and Goblint, Deagle and Dartagnan reached the time limit. iekke 2.0 (10.5281/zenodo.23243599) gives no answer on any task: its wrapper opens output_unwind_rounds.csv, which its archive does not contain, and ends with a FileNotFoundError, so check 2 fails here until iekke's archive is fixed.

tasks.name: goblint-regression/13-privatized_57-singlethreaded-unlock_true
tasks.purpose: Goblint answers true in 0.1 s, in phase 1 of svcomp27, and an unreach-call true needs a YAML 2.1+ correctness witness: CoOpeRace delivers Goblint's ghost_instrumentation witness of format 2.1, which ULTIMATE Automizer's correctness validator confirms. Goblint alone, without the option witness.yaml.entry-types that CoOpeRace adds, writes a witness WitnessLint rejects (two format versions). ULTIMATE GemCutter, Dartagnan and Deagle also answer true, later.

tasks.purpose: The unreach-call hand-over task (check 8). Goblint reached the time limit in SV-COMP 2026, and its svcomp27 version ends TIMEOUT at its CPU-time limit of 30 s in phase 1; Dartagnan then answers false in phase 2 with a witness that ULTIMATE Automizer's validator confirms.
